description: Land Acquisition - Godakanda, Bope-Poddala D/S Division, Galle District and Pitipana-North, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their boundaries, extents, and locations, along with orders for taking possession of these lands. While it mentions a government minister (Gayantha Karunatilleke), this is incidental to the main purpose of the document, which is land acquisition. The content fits squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it concerns "land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" and "land development projects."
